subject: Vendor onboarding refresh & scale-commit for renewal (capacity + PO)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@acme-corp.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-06T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding refresh + scale commit for renewal

Hi Connor,

We're starting our renewal packet for Redwood and need to refresh vendor onboarding in our procurement portal. Two items on our side: 1) we need an updated vendor packet with current corporate docs (W-9 / Tax ID, SOC2 evidence summary) and 2) confirmation on the capacity/commit change — we're proposing to move from 50 concurrent seats to 150 (expecting a Q1 spike).

Can you share the onboarding checklist and the quote for the capacity bump so procurement can generate the PO? Also confirm whether you can accept a split PO (one PO for the base renewal, one PO for the committed addendum) and the billing cadence options (monthly vs. quarterly invoicing).

We'd like to close procurement by the end of next week if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
ACME Corporation

Attachment: acme_proc_sched_note.txt (stub)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-06T12:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + scale commit for renewal

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Great to hear about the capacity bump. Quick plan and attachments below:

What I'm sending now:
- onboarding checklist (redwood_onboarding_refresh_checklist.pdf) — forms we need uploaded to your procurement portal
- capacity quote (capacity_bump_quote_2026-12-06.pdf) — line-item pricing for 50 -> 150 concurrent seats; includes volume discount tiers
- DocuSign SLA addendum draft (link below)

Answers to your questions:
- Split PO: we can accept a split PO (base renewal + committed capacity addendum). Finance will need separate line items and the addendum must reference the main contract number.
- Billing cadence: monthly or quarterly invoicing both supported. Net-30 by default; if your procurement requires NET45, mark it on the PO and we'll route to Finance for approval (see cc: Ben).

Next steps/requested actions:
1) Upload the onboarding checklist documents to the ACME procurement portal and attach the quote to the base renewal PO.
2) Sign SLA addendum via DocuSign (I can push a pre-filled envelope once we confirm term length).
3) Let us know if Finance requires a vendor form (Tax ID, W-9) — we'll attach the required docs.

I'll loop Rachel from Legal for the SLA tweaks and Marissa for onboarding coordination. If you want, we can do a 30-min call tomorrow to walk procurement through the portal.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_refresh_checklist.pdf, capacity_bump_quote_2026-12-06.pdf
DocuSign prep: https://docusign.com/link/abcdef-Redwood-ACME-SLA

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@acme-corp.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-07T08:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + scale commit for renewal

Hi Elena / team — looping Legal and Product Ops. A couple of notes from our side before DocuSign: 

- SLA addendum: attached is sla_addendum_v2.docx with the term-change language for committed capacity. We recommend a 12-month committed term for the bumped capacity with a 30-day notice for any step-downs after the initial period.
- Security evidence: SOC2 summary is ready; Rachel can provide the evidence matrix for procurement if needed.
- Procurement portal: use the Redwood enrollment link (https://console.redwood.ai/procurement/portal/enroll?ref=acme-2026). There is an option to pre-populate vendor fields — Connor, please confirm if you'd like us to pre-fill the Tax ID and remittance address.

Ben — any concerns about the split PO and NET45 requests?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sla_addendum_v2.docx

From: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-07T11:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + scale commit for renewal

Connor / Marissa — quick follow-ups from our procurement system: 
1) ACME requires Tax ID + W-9 for vendor setup (please attach).
2) PO template attached (acme_po_template.docx) — our system prefers NET45 for new contracts. If Redwood seeks Net-30, provide a brief email confirmation and we'll flag for expedited payment processing.
3) We will issue two POs if Redwood confirms split-line acceptance. The addendum must reference the primary PO number.

Also, can Redwood accept electronic invoices to invoices@acme-corp.com with the PO number in the subject?

Thanks,
Elena (on behalf of ACME Procurement)

Attachment: acme_po_template.docx

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-07T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + scale commit for renewal

Elena — Finance is OK to accept NET45 for this renewal given the strategic expansion; two notes: 1) we need the PO to reference the RDW master contract and 2) for the committed capacity addendum we require one invoice per billing cadence (we can split invoices but each must include the addendum reference).

Connor — please attach Tax ID/W-9 to the portal so ACME can complete vendor setup. Rachel, confirm any outstanding legal flags on the SLA addendum and I'll sign off on the finance side once Legal is clear.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@acme-corp.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-08T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + scale commit for renewal

Connor / team — good progress. We've started the portal vendor enrollment and uploaded the PO template. We'll issue the base PO today and the addendum PO after we receive the signed SLA addendum. Expect the base PO to list NET45; please confirm once you receive it so we can route for approval.

I'll also request electronic invoices to invoices@acme-corp.com with the PO number in the subject as instructed.

Elena

--
Thread status: Procurement portal enrollment in progress; awaiting DocuSign signature and portal Tax ID upload.
